trial_court: Principal Family Court - cum - IV Additional District Court, Vijayawada (Crl.M.P.No.738 of 2024 in FCOP.No.984 of 2018)
case_name: Nakka Mallikarjuna Vara Prasad v. Nakka Jayasri Bodi Jayasri
facts_of_case: The respondent-wife filed a petition for maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. The petitioner-husband filed a counter and later sought to reject the petition claiming lack of territorial jurisdiction, no cause of action disclosed, and suppression of material facts.

legal_principles.principle: Procedure under CPC, in particular Order VII Rule 11 CPC, would not be applicable to proceedings for maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
legal_principles.held: This Court is of the confirmed view that the procedure under CPC, in particular Order VII Rule 11 CPC would not be applicable to the proceedings for maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order VII Rule 11
cited_cases: Durgawati Devi v. Muktinath Tiwari, (Year) X SCC Y
Mohammad Nadeem v. State of U.P., {(2015) 2 All Cri R 2207}

legal_principles.principle: The provision of law applying Order VII Rule 11 CPC to the proceedings under Section 125 Cr.P.C. or any independent provision alike Order VII Rule 11 CPC in Cr.P.C. has not been placed before the Court.
legal_principles.held: Any provision of law applying Order VII Rule 11 CPC to the proceedings under Section 125 Cr.P.C. or any independent provision alike Order VII Rule 11 CPC in Cr.P.C. has not been placed before the Court.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order VII Rule 11
cited_cases: Durgawati Devi v. Muktinath Tiwari, (Year) X SCC Y
Mohammad Nadeem v. State of U.P., {(2015) 2 All Cri R 2207}

outcome.final_order: The challenge to the proceedings under Section 125 Cr.P.C or an order passed in those proceedings would be amenable to the jurisdiction of this Court under Article 227 of Constitution of India.
